description: This is a JUnit test class for the UserCreatedShelfUtils in a book management application. It tests functionality related to creating, managing, and retrieving books from user-created shelves, utilizing Spring Boot testing features.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfUtilsTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the functionality of user-created shelf utilities in the book project, including adding and retrieving books from custom shelves.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test case, creating custom shelves and adding books for testing.

methods.name: resetServices
methods.description: Clears data from services to ensure a clean test environment.

methods.name: createSetOfBooks
methods.description: Helper method to create and save a set of books with specified titles, associations to predefined and user-created shelves.

methods.name: createAndSaveBook
methods.description: Creates and persists a Book object with given title and shelf associations.

methods.name: addBooksToCustomShelves
methods.description: Assigns books to user-created shelves based on a predefined shelf.

methods.name: returnBooksSuccessfully
methods.description: Test case verifying that books can be successfully retrieved from a custom shelf.

methods.name: returnNoBooksIfNoBooksInCustomShelf
methods.description: Test case verifying that an empty set is returned when no books are in the shelf.

methods.name: returnNoBooksForNonExistentCustomShelf
methods.description: Test case checking the behavior when requesting books from a non-existent shelf, expecting an empty result.
